label: rem:categorical-lagrangian-remark
title: Bosonic and fermionic sectors of the categorical Lagrangian
html: The categorical Lagrangian is the categorical analogue of a Lagrangian density before integration over spacetime. Its first summand \mathcal{D}_\nabla^2 encodes the bosonic sector; the second summand encodes the fermionic coupling of the state to the connection.
heading: Remark
